rationale: Jamie's Twigg AI tackles context management for LLM workflows using Git-style version control—a pain point that directly intersects with Artem's deep expertise in LLM tooling and efficient inference optimization from his work at Nous Research and Osmosis AI. Artem's hands-on builder background with transformer architecture and real-time inference (loopvlm) complements Jamie's product focus on token efficiency and granular context control, creating natural potential for technical collaboration or design feedback.
intro_message: Jamie Borland, meet Artem Yatsenko — you're both focused on making LLM workflows faster and more controllable, and Artem's inference optimization expertise could directly inform how Twigg AI handles context and token efficiency.
